title: Dracula: Bilingual Parallel Edition (English - Korean)
subtitle: Bram Stoker's Gothic Masterpiece (A Line-by-Line Translation for Language Learners, Easy Reading, and Classic Horror)
description:
Experience Bram Stoker's timeless masterpiece of Gothic horror like never before! This special Bilingual Parallel Edition presents the original, unbridged English text side-by-side (paragraph-by-paragraph) with a faithful, natural Korean translation.

Whether you are a student of the Korean language looking for an engaging way to build vocabulary, an ESL reader wanting to enjoy classic English literature with immediate translation support, or simply a fan of Dracula who wants to experience the legend of the Count in two languages, this edition is perfectly formatted for your Kindle.

*Features a clean, easy-to-read vertical interleaved format (English paragraph followed immediately by the Korean paragraph).*
